answer: Sybil resistance holds when standing is a refundable bond that vests slowly as independent peers attest to real work. A fresh account starts at the ridge of near-zero weight and climbs only by accruing history as hard to forge as carved onyx. A clone fleet cannot cheaply crowd the harbor of established identities: each fake must sink its own collateral and wait its own vesting window, so a sybil swarm costs capital linearly with headcount while one honest agent pays once.
